description: Update policy for projects made from project-starter: the starter's (default.json), except majors. Projects use it with `"extends": ["github>skyrix-lang/project-starter:project"]` in renovate.json.

packageRules.description: Majors come from the starter: its own Renovate opens them, and the sync brings them here with the code changes they needed (docs/starter-sync.md). A major for a dependency only this project has waits in the Dependency Dashboard: tick it to open its pull request.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes, majors included, don't wait for the dashboard.
